description: This file contains selector functions for retrieving integration-related data from the application's global state, including hooks, commands, OAuth apps, and team-specific hooks, utilizing memoization with createSelector.

methods.name: getIncomingHooks
methods.description: Retrieves incoming webhook hooks from the global state.

methods.name: getIncomingHooksTotalCount
methods.description: Retrieves total count of incoming hooks.

methods.name: getOutgoingHooksInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing hooks for the current team.

methods.name: getAllCommands
methods.description: Combines commands and system commands into a single object.

methods.name: getAutocompleteCommandsList
methods.description: Retrieves commands eligible for auto-completion, filtered by current team.
